title: 第一卷 第14章 秘境开启，众人轻视
novel_title: 凡人修仙：疯了吧，你百岁高龄才入门
content_zh:
两日休整，转瞬即逝。

    清晨天光大亮，青云山巅灵气翻涌。

    外门数百弟子尽数集结山门广场。

    所有人身着统一青衫，背负法器、丹瓶，神色亢奋凝重。

    今日，正是青玄宗一年一度的青峦秘境开启之日。

    秘境藏于青云山脉深处，是上古遗留小界。

    里面遍布灵药、灵石矿脉、低级灵材，甚至残留上古修士的零碎传承。

    对挣扎在炼气低层的外门弟子而言，这就是实打实的造化之地。

    广场前方，数位内门执事、护法肃立。

    柳长老亦亲临此地，目光扫过全场弟子。

    最后，他的视线落在人群末尾那道白发佝偻的身影上。

    苏玄尘静静伫立，气息收敛至极。

    炼气二层的修为，被他压得毫无外泄，看起来平平无奇。

    若非昨日执事当众官宣，无人能看出他是极品天灵根。

    柳长老朗声开口，声音传遍全场：

    “青峦秘境，禁制松动，时限三日。”

    “秘境之内，可夺宝、可历练、可厮杀。”

    “但有一条底线——不可残杀同门性命。”

    “违令者，废除修为，逐出师门！”

    规矩简单粗暴。

    修仙界历练，本就是弱肉强食。

    只要不杀命，争夺、偷袭、掠夺，皆在允许范围之内。

    话音落下，下方弟子眼神愈发火热。

    三日时间，足够很多人彻底翻身。

    柳长老目光微顿，特意补了一句：

    “此次秘境，我重点看好一人。”
content_en:
Two days of rest, fleeting.

    The sky is bright in the early morning, and the spiritual energy on the top of Qingyun Mountain is surging.

    Hundreds of disciples from the outer sect gathered in the mountain gate square.

    Everyone was wearing uniform green shirts, carrying magic weapons and elixir bottles on their backs, and looked excited and dignified.

    Today is the day when Qingxuan Sect’s annual Qingluan Secret Realm opens.

    The secret realm is hidden deep in the Qingyun Mountains and is a small realm left over from ancient times.

    It is filled with elixirs, spirit stone veins, low-level spiritual materials, and even fragments of inheritance from ancient monks.

    For the outer disciples struggling at the lower level of Qi refining, this is a real place of creation.

    In front of the square, several inner gate deacons and protectors stood in awe.

    Elder Liu also came here in person and glanced at all the disciples present.

    Finally, his eyes fell on the white-haired figure at the end of the crowd.

    Su Xuanchen stood quietly, his aura extremely restrained.

    His cultivation at the second level of Qi Refining was suppressed by him without any leakage, and it looked ordinary.

    If it hadn't been for the official announcement made by the deacon in public yesterday, no one would have known that he had the best heavenly spiritual root.

    Elder Liu spoke loudly, and his voice spread throughout the audience:

    "Qingluan Secret Realm, the restrictions are loosened, the time limit is three days."

    "In the secret realm, you can win treasures, experience, and fight."

    "But there is a bottom line - don't kill your fellow disciples."

    "Those who disobey the order will have their cultivation level revoked and be expelled from the school!"

    The rules are simple and crude.

    Experience in the world of immortality is basically about the weak and the strong.

    As long as no one kills, fighting, sneak attacks, and plundering are all within the allowed scope.

    After the words fell, the eyes of the disciple below became more and more fiery.

    Three days is enough for many people to completely turn over.

    Elder Liu paused for a moment and added:

    "In this secret realm, I am focusing on one person."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 14 The secret realm is opened and everyone despises it
